question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 20 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The connection pool size change likely caused the connection exhaustion warnings.
why_chain: The auth db.pool_size was changed from 50 to 5.
This reduction in pool size likely caused the connection pool to exhaust more quickly.
The connection pool exhaustion led to the WARN messages in the logs.

contributing_factors.description: The increase in request volume did not cause the latency spike.
why_chain: The request volume for service auth stayed about the same.
The error rate increased, not the request volume.
The latency spike was more pronounced than the increase in requests.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in latency was due to a sudden surge in traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The latency increase was caused by a new deployment.
ruled_out.reason: No alerts or error logs were present before the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The latency increase was due to a dependency issue with an external service.
ruled_out.reason: No external service failures or slowdowns were reported.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for service auth rose from 91 ms to 293 ms (+223%), with a change point at 2026-03-20T04:05:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.01).
At the same time, request volume for service auth stayed about the same (1105 per 5 min before, 1235 per 5 min after, +12%).
At the same time, error rate for service auth rose (0.41% before, 0.56% after, +39%).
Changed auth db.pool_size from 50 to 5 (all regions) (auth; 2 min before the change; record R008)
p95 latency above SLO on auth (auth; 15 min after the change; record R010)
auth: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (auth, eu-west; 21 min after the change; record R011)
auth: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (auth, ap-south; 24 min after the change; record R012)
auth: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (auth, us-east; 24 min after the change; record R013)

reasons: ✓ A change event (config_changes) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Roll back the config change to restore the db.pool_size to 50.
Monitor the connection pool size and request volume closely in the future.
Review and optimize the connection pool configuration for the auth service.
